concerns.ruleBody:
Concern names use condition terms only — blood sugar · blood pressure · sleep. Disease names (diabetes · hypertension · insomnia) are not used.

We say “popular ingredients”, not “effective ingredients”. Concern names and descriptions read as ad copy, so they go through automatic pre-screening.
concerns.notice: Concerns group the popular ingredients people look for with each concern. Health functional foods are not medicines for preventing or treating disease, and the stated functions are within the scope recognized by the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety.

ingredients.hint: In health foods, the unit of comparison is not the product but ingredient × amount × monthly price. That’s why ingredients are the primary axis.
